text: Please can someone help me, I'm minding my grandson tonight, he's 16 months. His temperature is 40°C. He's got little dark red dots coming up on his legs and tummy, like tiny pinpricks, and a couple of bigger purply bits like bruises. I pressed a glass on them like I've seen on the telly and they're still there, you can see them clear as anything through the glass. They don't go away at all. His mum's on a night shift and I can't get hold of her. I'm shaking typing this
